chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 2 — Primary Source (3 points) — Set 2
chunks.content: AP European History SAQ 2 (Primary Source), 3 points, one per part. Set 2 prompts (a cartoon): A [1] describe a likely purpose of the cartoon; B [1] describe a relevant religious context for the cartoon; C [1] explain one way the development of the French monarchy in the 1600s led to a stated outcome. 'Describe' = relevant characteristics; 'Explain' = how/why. Common failure: A describing content instead of purpose; C describing without explaining the causal link.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2A, 3/3
chunks.content: SAQ 2 (Set 2) scored 3/3 (A 1, B 1, C 1). Described the cartoon's purpose, a relevant religious context, and explained a consequence of the 1600s French monarchy's development. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2B, 2/3
chunks.content: SAQ 2 (Set 2) scored 2/3 (A 1, B 1, C 0). Described the cartoon's purpose (A) and a religious context (B) but did not explain the causal link for C. Illustrates losing the Explain part while handling purpose and context.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2C, 1/3
chunks.content: SAQ 2 (Set 2) scored 1/3 (A 1, B 0, C 0). Described the cartoon's purpose only. Lost B (no valid religious context) and C (no causal explanation). Illustrates a response confined to source purpose.
